items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: Kramer tells us that, I don't know whether it's out or not.

ctx.x: But he said, it sounded like Jelly Roll too because he said he was a little slight, kind of light complected fellow. I bet you, but it never occurred to me because I never knew he played with.

Oh, yeah, they were hooked with the fellow, Carl Kramer that was with the band that booked Jelly and all, they booked him, you heard that story about him being booked in Milwaukee? They thought they would put out a jazz, they were handling higher class bands, you know, society bands, and they hadn't thought about handling a jazz band, but they got the idea and Jelly Roll was around and they asked him if he could organize a jazz band, he said, sure, I can find this musician around. He said, I got a good band,…
